interface.signature: leastInterval(N: int, K: int, tasks: List[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The cooldown period K must be between 0 and 100.
All tasks must be represented by upper-case English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum units of time required to complete all tasks.
The minimum time required must be at least the number of tasks.
The minimum time required must not exceed the calculated maximum time based on the most frequent task.
